Reason...

February 27, 2006

Looks like, I have few more good days left in my life. Am gonna stay in tocuh with her for a while atleast. We have to move on, in our lives and for that we need each other. Thats ironical. :-D But I love to see this rebel in her and myself. We did so many crazy things in past 10 days. Best days of my life ever. Will post in detail. Right now, a small poem, which I gave her, as gift for the poem that she gave me…

When empty heart takes over mind,
When drapes of insanity turns me blind.
And i am hanging on hopes just by the seam,
You are my reason for everything I dream.
You are my reason for living through days,
You are the reason for my crazy ways.
You are my sunshine for morning so bright,
In darkest hour, my eternal light.
And then you are not just a reason anymore,
But my “smile” itself, which widens more and more.

love u sweetheart!
